questions.question: What is the best approach to bulkify a trigger that needs related records?

questions.question: Which two are asynchronous Apex mechanisms? (Choose 2)
questions.explanation: Queueable and Batch Apex (along with @future and Scheduled Apex) run asynchronously. Triggers and validation rules run synchronously.

questions.question: Which interface must a class implement to be run by System.schedule?
questions.explanation: A class implementing the Schedulable interface (with an execute(SchedulableContext) method) can be scheduled.

questions.question: Which async option supports job chaining and passing non-primitive (sObject) state?
questions.explanation: Queueable Apex can chain jobs via System.enqueueJob in execute and accepts complex member variables; @future only takes primitives and cannot chain.

questions.question: Which Apex classes are used to make an outbound REST callout?
questions.explanation: You build an HttpRequest, then send it with an Http instance to receive an HttpResponse.

questions.question: Which two techniques help avoid hitting the Apex CPU time limit? (Choose 2)
options: Move heavy logic to asynchronous Apex
Add more triggers on the object
questions.explanation: Offloading work to async contexts (which get higher limits) and reducing per-record work both cut CPU time. Extra triggers and nested loops increase it.

questions.question: Which annotation runs a method asynchronously in its own transaction and can be allowed to make callouts?
questions.explanation: @future(callout=true) runs asynchronously and permits HTTP callouts; it only accepts primitive parameters.

questions.question: What is the recommended way to keep trigger logic maintainable?
options: Delegate to a trigger handler class
Put all logic directly in the trigger body
questions.explanation: One trigger per object that delegates to a handler class keeps logic testable and organized.

questions.question: Which methods reset governor limits and force async jobs to run in a test?
questions.explanation: Code between Test.startTest() and Test.stopTest() gets a fresh set of limits, and async operations complete at stopTest().

questions.question: Which two Salesforce features let external systems push data into Salesforce? (Choose 2)

questions.explanation: The Atlas Reasoning Engine interprets the request, builds a plan, and orchestrates the actions needed to fulfill it.
